title: State-Dependent Affine Bellman Barriers, Asymptotic Equivalence, and the Institutional U-Curve: Analytical Extensions on Minimum Viable Scale
description: Analytical extensions, sharpened First Passage Bellman Barrier (FPBB) certificates, interval-arithmetic proofs, asymptotic fixed- vs. endogenous-labor equivalence with continuous-state VFI, and Barro-CES institutional, decentralization, balanced-growth, and stochastic generalizations building on Milei and Reidel (2026), 'Minimum Viable Scale: Bellman Barriers and the Economics of Survival'. Includes synchronized English and Spanish manuscripts (PDF/Typst/LaTeX), figure-generation scripts, and reproducible verification code.
notes: Includes bilingual preprints: mvs_improvements_en.pdf (English, 22 pp.) and mvs_mejoras_paper.pdf (Spanish, 25 pp.). Analytical development, technical editing, and Python verification routines were assisted by AI tools under the author's direction, critical review, and sole responsibility.
